points.why: The answer says the up-front label lands as an accusation and that the team can only contest the analyst's label and model.
It starts from a blank board and the team's own description of the problem, then draws each link as they speak and checks it with them.
Letting the room name the pattern first is covered, but pushback is treated only as correction to accept, not as a link or boundary to defend or fix.
Blame-free system language is covered well, but it never distinguishes stakeholders consulted from those merely informed.
